reviewer_scope: fresh context-free oral-level review with independent web search

nearest_prior_work: Explaining Data Mixing Scaling Laws: attacked Equation 1/3 and MRE; H007 audits metric lineage.
Data Mixing Laws: mixture-conditioned prediction but no treatment-dependent inclusion mask.
Chen et al. 2023 outcome-dependent missingness: general bias theory, not this benchmark audit.
statcheck: reporting checks without benchmark-mask estimands.
strongest_objections: Refitted heldout halves cannot establish inflation of the published Table 2 estimand.
Equal weighting of low-weight extrapolation cells needs scientific justification.
Advantage shrinkage and bootstrap aggregation are unstable when the baseline gap is near zero.

nearest_prior_work: DataDecide: forced target means; H008 adds confidence-filtered abstention.
Selective prediction sets: general abstention and coverage guarantees.
Ranking-and-selection: indifference zones and probability of correct selection.
Equivalence testing: requires a practical interval rather than failure to reject zero.
strongest_objections: Target replicates determine abstention, so the rule is unavailable at proxy decision time.
A zero-crossing confidence interval is not an equivalence test without an indifference margin.
Metric hashes share recipes, seeds, checkpoints, and correlated likelihood metrics.

nearest_prior_work: Olmix: attacked K=c(m+1) collapse; H009 changes the denominator to absolute heldout regret.
RegMix: swarm regression without dimension-varying sample complexity.
Scaling Laws for Optimal Data Mixtures: scale extrapolation without normalization audit.
HPO x ELA: common best-found normalization in optimization benchmarking.
strongest_objections: A finite 20% released-mixture oracle has dimension-dependent approximation error.
Non-nested domain semantics confound domain count with objective landscape.
One budget, three seeds, and two scales cannot isolate normalization from model misspecification.

nearest_prior_work: Data Mixture Optimization: attacked single simulator and speedups; H010 propagates simulator uncertainty.
Statistical Uncertainty Analysis for Stochastic Simulation: bootstraps metamodel input uncertainty.
Kriging and bootstrap simulation-optimization survey: propagates metamodel variability to optima.
Data-Driven Ranking and Selection Under Input Uncertainty: optimizer winner instability from estimated worlds.
strongest_objections: The statement is conjunctive while the support rule uses an OR.
Bootstrap refits are not automatically equally admissible benchmark worlds.
Metric halves share training runs, architecture, pool, and policies.

nearest_prior_work: GRAPE: attacked raw-variance theorem; H011 gives a strongly convex counterexample.
Gradient Surgery: gradient-conflict conditions without GRAPE variance analysis.
Gradient Coordination: alignment and loss reduction, not this theorem.
Information Transfer in MTL: positive-transfer conditions without normalized/raw variance audit.
strongest_objections: Global bounded-gradient and strong-convexity assumptions may be incompatible with the quadratic construction.
One source removes the defining mixture degree of freedom unless singleton scope is universal.
The seven-dimensional confirmation is underspecified and AD is not independent of an exact identity.

nearest_prior_work: GRAPE: exact audited source; H012 checks duplicate-cell identity.
statcheck: automatic statistical inconsistency checking.
TAB-AUDIT: likelihood-based fabricated-table detection rather than deterministic joins.
PaperAudit-Bench: general paper-error detection benchmark.
strongest_objections: Visible labels do not exclude hidden checkpoint, seed, correction, or version differences.
A local discrepancy does not identify the correct table or reverse a scientific conclusion.
Odd/even columns are not independent evidence from one PDF.
